caption: The drawing features an oval-shaped frame with two concentric borders in shades of brown and beige. Inside the frame is a profile portrait relief in white and light gray, showing a man facing to the right. The man has long hair tied back with a ribbon, and he is wearing a coat with epaulets and a high-collared shirt with ruffled detailing at the chest. The background within the innermost oval is dark brown, providing contrast to the lighter figure and enhancing the appearance of depth and dimension in the image. The outer area of the drawing is a light, cream-colored surface. There are no additional objects or text present in the composition.
title: Bust of Washington
